name: Seikyouiku ~Monster Parent no Rifujin na Youkyuu~
original_name: 性狂育 ～モンスターペアレントの理不尽な要求～
source:
At the end of Hayase Risa 2nd year of her teaching life, and incident happened in the class that she was in charge.

A certain boy, tried to have his way on a certain girl.

She was there just by chance, it was an authentic rape attempt regardless of how anyone saw it.

However, because it took place in the school, the incident was decided to not be made public.

One day after the incident, Risa received a phone apology from the father of the boy that started the incident.

And from the same father, she got a proposal to change the sex education.

 "The rape incident happened because there wasn't an adequate sexual knowledge" or so he said.

Although she thought that "there's some truth in that opinion", she noticed that this phone apology was more in the form of him shifting responsibilities.

However, there was a reason why Risa wasn't able to turn down his proposal.

And it was that that boy's father... Kurata Michio, was what is called a monster parent.
translation:
早濑理彩执教的第二年即将结束时，她担任班主任的班级发生了一起事件。

一名男生试图强行侵犯另一名女生。

理彩恰好来到现场。无论从任何人的角度看，这都是一起确凿无疑的强奸未遂事件。

然而，由于事件发生在校内，校方最终决定不对外公开。

事发的第二天，理彩接到了肇事男生父亲打来的道歉电话。

可就在同一通电话里，这位父亲又向她提议改变学校的性教育方式。

他声称：“之所以会发生强奸事件，是因为学生没有掌握足够的性知识。”

理彩虽然觉得“这种说法多少有些道理”，却也察觉到，这通所谓的道歉电话，更像是对方在推卸责任。

可是，理彩无法直接拒绝他的提议。

因为那名男生的父亲——仓田道夫——正是人们所说的“怪兽家长”。
